title: Release builds resolve Maven and npm dependencies through Chainguard Libraries; a weekly workflow reports coverage gaps

criteria.then: writes a settings profile adding Chainguard (libraries.cgr.dev/java) as repository and pluginRepository, consulted first with Central still reachable (no wildcard mirror), keeps the five GitHub Packages servers

criteria.given: release.yml npm jobs and the composite action
criteria.then: release builds keep the normal npmjs registry (no per-package fallback); the chainguard-npm composite (temporary .npmrc, no committed credentials) exists for the coverage job
has a workflow_dispatch skip_chainguard input (default off) that logs a warning, and the jar job does not cache ~/.m2
runs on schedule and workflow_dispatch only, with contents: read, resolves Maven (no fallback) and npm ci --ignore-scripts through Chainguard only, and writes a job summary
ci.yml is untouched by Chainguard and every uses: is pinned by full SHA
docs/chainguard-libraries.md exists and docs/releasing.md links to it
